headline: Revenue accelerates, margins narrow on hardware mix
summary_short: CDW's Q2 revenue rose 10.0% y/y to $6,572.2M as commercial, government and UK/Canada demand strengthened, while gross margin slipped 70bp to 20.1% on a lower-margin hardware mix; diluted EPS grew 5.1% to $2.15.
summary_long: Net sales grew 10.0% y/y (9.9% constant currency) to $6,572.2M, led by Government (+13.6%) and UK/Canada (+22.9%), with Corporate commercial customers up 10.7%. Gross margin fell 70bp y/y to 20.1% on mix into lower-margin hardware categories, partly offset by higher netted-down revenue. S&A rose 8.6% on higher incentive compensation and workplace-optimization costs, holding operating margin to 6.5% (non-GAAP 8.5%). Net income rose 1.2% to $274.4M as a higher effective tax rate (26.4% vs 25.7%) offset operating gains; non-GAAP net income rose 7.8%. Diluted EPS was $2.15, up 5.1%. Cash fell to $361.8M from $618.7M at year-end amid financing outflows exceeding operating cash generation; the board declared a $0.630/share quarterly dividend, payable September 10, 2026.

drivers.explanation: Company cited customer demand across data storage/servers, notebooks/mobile devices, software and netcomm; Government (+13.6%) and UK/Canada (+22.9%) grew fastest of the reporting segments.
Gross profit dollars rose with sales, but margin fell 70bp to 20.1% as mix shifted into lower-margin hardware categories, partly offset by a higher share of netted-down revenue.
Operating income growth lagged sales growth as S&A rose 8.6% on higher performance-based compensation and workplace-optimization costs, per the release.
Net income growth (+1.2%) trailed non-GAAP net income growth (+7.8%) because the effective tax rate rose to 26.4% from 25.7% on prior-year excess tax benefits not repeating.
EPS growth (+5.1%) outpaced net income growth (+1.2%) arithmetically: weighted average diluted shares fell to 127.4M from 132.4M y/y.
Cash decline to $361.8M is explained by financing outflows (-$406.2M YTD) exceeding operating cash generation (+$219.7M YTD); the release states no additional qualitative cause.
Management attributes results to customer investment in infrastructure modernization, cloud and AI-enabled technology, citing its diversified portfolio and services-led strategy as advantages.
